title: Reshoot-Anything: 4D-Anchor Controlled Video Viewpoint Synthesis
summary: A self-supervised video diffusion system that enables changing camera trajectories in monocular footage. It uses 4D point-cloud anchors derived from source video to provide geometric conditioning for consistent viewpoint synthesis.
research_notes: Developed by Morphic Films; includes a specialized 4D Visualizer for manual camera trajectory keyframing in reconstructed point-cloud spaces.

evolution.summary: The project evolved from basic frame-interpolation to a full 4D-anchor controlled workflow using the Wan diffusion series. As of May 2026, it supports the Wan 2.7 architecture for high-fidelity camera control and instruction-based editing.
